primary_meaning: God's elect/covenant people (Israel/the Church as spiritual Israel)

alternatives.meaning: type of the individual believer who struggles with God, is disciplined, and is transformed/prevails
type or foreshadowing of Christ (via Jacob's ladder or the prevailing one)
historical patriarch without strong typological/symbolic overlay (or primarily contrast to Esau as flesh vs spirit)

notes: In Christian interpretation Jacob is most consistently taken as representative of the covenant people (interchangeable with 'Israel' in OT prophecy and NT election language). Typological readings of his personal story as the struggling believer are also widespread but secondary to the national/elect-people sense; pure historical readings coexist without displacing the symbolic consensus.
